parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of the caplog fixture not restoring the log level after a test, but it introduces a new attribute and logic that may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new attribute `_initial_handler_level` and logic to restore it, which may have unintended side effects on other parts of the codebase that rely on the handler's level.
The patch could be more readable by adding comments to explain the purpose of the new attribute and the logic added to restore it.
